brief:
Israeli officials express concern that international demonstrations against the occupation are transitioning from grassroots activism into formal diplomatic channels, Shehab Wire reported. Protests have been visible across streets, universities, and media outlets worldwide, but Israeli worry centers on the movement now reaching foreign ministries and diplomatic corridors, including those of traditionally allied nations.

The shift from public dissent to official government positions represents a potential turning point in international response to Israeli policies, marking a phase beyond symbolic solidarity among activists.

title: Israel fears street protests escalating to government policy shifts
